name: a-star
description: A* pathfinding algorithm on a 2D grid that finds the shortest path using heuristic-guided search.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to find the optimal path between two points on a 2D grid with obstacles, such as game maps, robot navigation, or maze solving. Faster than Dijkstra when a good heuristic is available.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: 2D array where 0 = passable cell and 1 = obstacle.

parameters.name: heuristic
parameters.description: Optional heuristic function (a, b) => number. Defaults to Manhattan distance.
